checks.name: Article panel: A required positive JSON-number capacity, with guarded conversion
checks.sql:
CREATE TABLE teaware_documents (
  product_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES products,
  details jsonb NOT NULL,
  CHECK (jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'),
  CHECK (details ? 'capacity_ml'),
  CHECK (CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(details -> 'capacity_ml') = 'number'
      THEN (details ->> 'capacity_ml')::numeric > 0
    ELSE false
  END)
);
INSERT INTO teaware_documents VALUES
  ('P7', '{"capacity_ml":300}');

Article panel: Retain a document identity and each array occurrence
checks.sql:
SELECT p.label, e.position, e.tag
FROM tag_probe AS p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL
  jsonb_array_elements(p.doc -> 'tags')
  WITH ORDINALITY AS e(tag, position)
WHERE p.label = 'repeated'
ORDER BY e.position;
-- repeated | 1 | "gift"
-- repeated | 2 | "ceramic"
-- repeated | 3 | "gift"

checks.name: Article panel: Build an order response from existing relational order lines
checks.sql:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'order_id', o.order_id,
  'status', o.status,
  'lines', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'line_no', i.line_no, 'product_id', i.product_id,
      'quantity', i.quantity, 'unit_price', i.unit_price
    ) ORDER BY i.line_no)
    FROM order_items AS i
    WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS response
FROM orders AS o
WHERE o.order_id = 103;
